name: ChartCategory
description: Represents all chart categories in the document, whether visible (unfiltered) or not.
remarks: Use the IsFiltered property to determine which categories are visible and which are filtered out.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ChartCategory object.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the name of a chart category. Read/write.

properties.name: IsFiltered
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that determines whether the specified chart category is filtered out from the chart. Read/write.
